title: 第5章 家事
slug: 重生七零逆袭路全本免费-重生七零逆袭路最新章节列表
content_zh:
“妈妈，去吧去吧！带上哥哥一起。上次听小舅说，哥哥在学前班学习可厉害啦！次次考第一。爸爸要是知道，肯定也会高兴的。”周园园添了一把火。
听园园说起周家胜上学前班的事，赵芸香的嘴角不由得往上翘了翘。
今年九月份，三合镇上的雏鹰幼儿园，招收一批六到八岁的学龄前儿童，办一个学前班。
雏鹰幼儿园是三合镇唯一的一家幼儿园，里面的孩子大都是父母在镇上有单位有工作的。雏鹰幼儿园在三合镇周边村子里，就是后世的“贵族学校“的存在。
在那个年代，家家户户孩子都多，从大到小一大串的，一家有三五个亲兄妹是很常见的事。孩子虽然多，却没有哪一家农户会把自家孩子送到幼儿园去的。很多人认为，孩子到了八岁直接去上小学就好了，上什么幼儿园？浪费！
孩子多了，父母身上的负担也重了，在农村里，一家大小能填饱肚子都是一件奢侈的事。哪有闲钱去上幼儿园？
但是，看见雏鹰幼儿园出来的小朋友们一个个穿的干净整洁而又有礼貌，村民们还是很羡慕的。
雏鹰幼儿园这次的学前班招收二十人，最重要的是，这次的学前班，不用自己掏钱，学费和生活费都由镇上出，算是给三合镇给下属单位的福利。
赵芸香的弟弟赵国辉是三合镇供销社的主任，刚好在上半年被评为工作先进模范，所以获得了一个免费上幼儿园的名额。
赵国辉刚结婚不久，自己还没有孩子。赵国辉和老婆徐丽琴商量了一下，干脆把这个名额给了赵芸香的儿子周家胜。一来，赵国辉只有赵芸香这么一个亲姐姐，外甥周家胜今年刚好满六周岁，符合学前班的招生条件。二来，镇上的领导说了，自家没有符合年龄的孩子，亲戚家的也可以。
周家胜能去镇上上学，赵芸香当然高兴。这个年纪的孩子，正是精力充沛而又爱淘气的时候。周家胜除了每天帮妈妈做些力所能及的事，剩下的大把时间就是和一大堆孩子在一起，满村子地疯玩。
周家胜聪明伶俐的，从小就喜欢学习。周志新在家的时候，为孩子们买了一堆小人书。周家胜看到津津有味的，经常缠着赵芸香教他认书上的字，不知不觉的，周家胜认识的字不算少了。
要不是赵芸香在周家过的艰难，早就想让园园兄妹俩去镇上上幼儿园了。在赵芸香看来，学多点知识是好事，保不准什么时候就用上了。
赵芸香自己初中毕业，在农村里算是有点文化的。正因为她看的懂服装书上的款式和裁剪比例，才学会了一手裁缝的好手艺。
赵芸香缝制的衣服，有时会在在收腰处多打一个褶子，有时会在裤脚处收小两分，做出来愣是比别的裁缝做的看起来好看。所以周家村很多大姑娘小媳妇，都喜欢找赵芸香做衣服。
周家胜上学后，每个星期一，赵国辉都会起个大早从三合镇赶到周家村，接周家胜去镇上。赵国辉有自行车，从三合镇到周家村，二十多分钟就够了。要是让赵芸香自己走路送孩子上学，差不多要花一个多小时。
到星期六下午学校放假，赵国辉才会把外甥送回周家。
周家胜喜欢学习，性格也很不错，在学前班经常受到老师的表扬。对于一个母亲来说，没有什么比的上看着自家孩子出息来的高兴。
园园说的话，算是说进赵芸香心坎里去了。这半年来，周家胜的变化很大，从一个淘小子变成了一个斯斯文文的小男孩，赵芸香真的很想让丈夫周志新看看，他们的儿子，长大了。
可是，从周家村去周志新的部队，要坐汽车还要坐火车。周志新每个月寄回家工资，赵芸香都一分不落地交给吴金凤了。赵芸香自己空闲时帮人做衣服，一件也就收三几毛的加工费，平时家里油盐什么的都要开支，可以说，赵芸香的口袋里根本没剩下几块钱。

“园园，我们还是在家等你爸爸回来吧！说不定，你爸爸已经动身了呢？再说了，妈妈身上??????没有钱。”后面的三个字赵芸香说的很轻，要不是周园园的听力很好，两人又靠的近，周园园根本听不到她在说什么。
周园园一想，明白了赵芸香的难处。

content_en:
"Mom, go ahead, go ahead! Take your brother with you. Last time I heard from my uncle that my brother is very good at studying in preschool! He always comes first in the exam. If Dad knows, he will definitely be happy." Zhou Yuanyuan added to the anger.
Hearing Yuanyuan talk about Zhou Jiasheng going to preschool, Zhao Yunxiang couldn't help but curl up the corners of her mouth.
In September this year, Young Eagle Kindergarten in Sanhe Town will enroll a group of preschool children aged six to eight to run a preschool class.
Young Eagle Kindergarten is the only kindergarten in Sanhe Town. Most of the children there have parents who have jobs in the town. Young Eagle Kindergarten was located in the villages surrounding Sanhe Town and was the “noble school” of later generations.
In that era, every household had many children, ranging from eldest to youngest. It was very common for a family to have three or five brothers and sisters. Although there are many children, no farmer will send his children to kindergarten. Many people think that children should go directly to elementary school when they are eight years old. What kind of kindergarten should they go to? waste!
With more children, the burden on parents becomes heavier. In rural areas, it is a luxury for the whole family to fill their stomachs. How can I have spare money to go to kindergarten?
However, the villagers were still envious when they saw all the children coming out of Young Eagle Kindergarten dressed neatly and politely.
The preschool class of Young Eagle Kindergarten enrolls twenty people. The most important thing is that this preschool class does not have to pay for itself. The tuition and living expenses are paid by the town, which is considered as a benefit to Sanhe Town for its subordinate units.
Zhao Yunxiang's younger brother Zhao Guohui is the director of the Sanhe Town Supply and Marketing Cooperative. He happened to be rated as an advanced model in the first half of the year, so he received a free place in kindergarten.
Zhao Guohui had just gotten married and had no children yet. Zhao Guohui and his wife Xu Liqin discussed it and simply gave the spot to Zhao Yunxiang's son Zhou Jiasheng. First of all, Zhao Guohui only has an older sister like Zhao Yunxiang. His nephew Zhou Jiasheng is just six years old this year and meets the enrollment requirements for preschool. Secondly, the town leaders said that if they didn’t have children of the same age at home, those from relatives would be fine.
Of course Zhao Yunxiang is happy that Zhou Jiasheng can go to school in the town. Children at this age are energetic and naughty. In addition to helping his mother do whatever he can every day, Zhou Jiasheng spends a lot of time with a lot of children, playing wildly in the village.
Zhou Jiasheng is smart and has loved learning since he was a child. When Zhou Zhixin was at home, he bought a bunch of little human books for his children. Zhou Jiasheng enjoyed seeing it and often pestered Zhao Yunxiang to teach him how to read the characters in the book. Unconsciously, Zhou Jiasheng knew quite a few characters.
If Zhao Yunxiang hadn't had a difficult time in the Zhou family, she would have wanted the Yuanyuan brother and sister to go to kindergarten in the town. In Zhao Yunxiang's view, it is a good thing to learn more knowledge, and you can't guarantee when you will use it.
Zhao Yunxiang graduated from junior high school and was somewhat educated in the countryside. It was precisely because she understood the styles and cutting proportions in clothing books that she learned the skills of tailoring.
The clothes sewn by Zhao Yunxiang sometimes have an extra pleat at the waist, and sometimes the trouser legs are tightened by two points. They look better than those made by other tailors. Therefore, many girls and wives in Zhoujia Village like to ask Zhao Yunxiang to make clothes.
After Zhou Jiasheng went to school, Zhao Guohui would get up early every Monday and rush to Zhoujia Village from Sanhe Town to take Zhou Jiasheng to town. Zhao Guohui has a bicycle, and it takes more than 20 minutes to get from Sanhe Town to Zhoujia Village. If Zhao Yunxiang were to walk to send her children to school, it would take more than an hour.
Zhao Guohui would not send his nephew back to Zhou's home until the school holiday on Saturday afternoon.
Zhou Jiasheng likes to study and has a good personality. He is often praised by teachers in preschool. For a mother, there is nothing better than the joy of watching her children prosper.
What Yuanyuan said,It was said that it entered Zhao Yunxiang's heart. In the past six months, Zhou Jiasheng has changed a lot, from a naughty boy to a gentle little boy. Zhao Yunxiang really wants to show her husband Zhou Zhixin that their son has grown up.
However, to go from Zhoujiacun to Zhou Zhixin's army, you have to take a car or a train. Zhou Zhixin sent home his salary every month, and Zhao Yunxiang handed over every penny to Wu Jinfeng. Zhao Yunxiang helps others make clothes in her free time, and only charges a processing fee of 30 cents per piece. She usually spends money on oil, salt, etc. at home. It can be said that Zhao Yunxiang doesn't have a few dollars left in her pocket.
"Yuanyuan, let's wait for your father to come back at home! Maybe your father has already left? Besides, mom has no money." Zhao Yunxiang said the last three words very softly. If it weren't for Zhou Yuanyuan's good hearing and the two people were so close, Zhou Yuanyuan would not be able to hear what she was saying.
Zhou Yuanyuan thought about it and understood Zhao Yunxiang's difficulty.
